title: The Ocean Spot Where Astronauts Are Your Closest Neighbors
titles: The Ocean Spot Where Astronauts Are Your Closest Neighbors
Why Astronauts Are Closer To Point Nemo Than Anyone On Earth
The Loneliest Place On Earth Is In The Ocean
hook: This is the most remote oceanic location.

scenes.text: This is the most remote oceanic location.
It is about 1,670 miles away from the nearest land in any direction.
That extreme isolation creates a very strange space trivia fact.
When the International Space Station passes overhead at about 250 miles high
those astronauts are over 6 times closer to Point Nemo than any human on land.
Space agencies even use this empty region as a spacecraft cemetery.
More than 200 discarded machines now rest on the dark seafloor below.
